title: DepotNode
description: Derived state of one physical storage location in the graph. A depot node's health is PHYSICAL (storage conditions) rather than GEOPOLITICAL (sourcing concentration) - it is the only node type whose status comes from a sensor instead of from a sourcing model. Emitted by services/api, consumed by web/ as a graph node.

label.description: Human label rendered on the graph node, e.g. 'SNS Depot 01 - Bin A (6-APA)'.

material.description: What is in the bin. For the demo: '6-APA'. Free text; not a controlled vocabulary.

storage_class.description: USP <659> storage class. Determines the band in `spec`.

spec.description: The band this bin is held to. Server-supplied so the device never has to be reflashed to change policy.

temp_c_excursion_min.description: Brief excursions permitted down to this, per USP <659>.

temp_c_excursion_max.description: Brief excursions permitted up to this, per USP <659>.

mkt_c_max.description: Mean kinetic temperature ceiling. THIS is the criterion that condemns stock, not an instantaneous reading.

rh_pct_max.description: ICH Q1A long-term RH ceiling. Beta-lactams hydrolyse; moisture is the real degradation driver for 6-APA.

status.description: ok = in band. excursion = out of band longer than dwell_s. mkt_breach = time-weighted heat load has condemned the stock; this one does not clear when the room cools. sensor_fault = the authoritative sensor is silent, or it disagrees with the cross-check beyond tolerance - the bin cannot be certified either way. stale = no reading within stale_after_s. offline = never reported. Precedence: mkt_breach > sensor_fault > excursion > stale > offline > ok.

reason.description: One sentence, demo-legible. Rendered directly in the UI.

latest.description: Most recent reading. Null before first contact.

pressure_hpa.description: RECORDED, NOT SCORED. A single absolute barometer cannot certify a storage area; cleanroom pressure cascades are differential. Kept for the two-sensor upgrade and to detect HVAC loss.

gas_ohms.description: BME680 VOC plate resistance in ohms; LOWER means more volatiles. Needs burn-in for absolute meaning - trend only. Warehouse-smoke signal, never a storage criterion.

temp_c_xcheck.description: DHT11 temperature. NOT authoritative - +/-2 C is 40% of a 20-25 C band. Exists so that disagreement with the BME680 can raise sensor_fault.

rh_pct_xcheck.description: DHT11 humidity. Cross-check only; DHT11 is only rated 20-80% RH.

mq2_mv.description: MQ-2 AOUT in millivolts, divider-corrected and eFuse-calibrated. Uncalibrated against any gas standard - trend only. Never report a ppm.

mkt_c.description: Mean kinetic temperature over `window_h`, per USP <1079> / ICH Q1A, dH = 83.144 kJ/mol.

window_h.description: Hours of history the MKT was computed over. Short in demo mode; say so on stage.

mkt_provisional.description: True when the observation window is shorter than the bin's min_window_s. MKT is still reported but MUST NOT be treated as a storage determination - a mean kinetic temperature over four minutes is a thermometer with extra steps. The service refuses to latch a breach while this is true.

excursion_s.description: Seconds continuously out of band. Resets on return to band; MKT does not.

covers_drugs.description: Drug nodes downstream of this bin. This is the edge that makes a thermometer a graph node: a spoiled bin fails the same drugs a shut plant would.

device_id.description: Which device last reported for this bin.
